notes.title: We are live on Steam! Get 10% discount during the launch week.
notes.content:
God of Light: Remastered is now live on Steam! Get the game during the launch week and receive 10% discount! 

God of Light: Remastered includes all available game DLCs with 150 game levels as well as full-length game tracks by UNKLE. 

The game supports all types of game controllers as well as mouse and keyboard. Windows laptops with touchscreen can also enjoy the original controls to manipulate light with a touch of a finger. 

We hope you will enjoy the game!
